title: Titan Forge read-only tools for an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
status: DOCUMENTATION_ONLY — not deployed. No AWS account is connected to this node.

gateway.summary: AgentCore Gateway converts APIs, Lambda functions and existing services into MCP-compatible tools (verified in the AgentCore developer guide, 2026-10-25). Each tool below maps to one read-only GET route of this app, so the natural target type is an OpenAPI/REST target behind an authenticated public URL (this node listens on 127.0.0.1 only and is not reachable from AWS today).
gateway.targetType: OpenAPI (REST) target — or a Lambda proxy that performs the same GETs
gateway.auth: Inbound: AgentCore Identity (e.g. Cognito/OAuth). Outbound to Titan Forge: an API key or OAuth client issued by the operator. Neither exists yet.
gateway.policy: Every tool is readOnlyHint:true. No tool can sign, pay, launch, start a loop or change state. AgentCore Policy (Cedar-compatible) can additionally deny anything not in this list.

payments: AgentCore Payments (x402/MPP) documents Coinbase CDP and Stripe (Privy) wallet providers. It does NOT document XRPL settlement; Titan Forge does not assume AWS settles on XRPL.

tools.name: tf_get_xdlc_radar
tools.description: TG Intelligence XDLC corridor radar: proposed-amendment corridors and their current (simulated/observed) signals. XDLC is a proposal, not live on XRPL.

tools.name: tf_list_sentinel_findings
tools.description: Titan Sentinel unified findings registry (each finding carries provenance: real, simulated or unavailable).

tools.name: tf_get_findings_summary
tools.description: Counts of Sentinel findings by severity, status and provenance.

tools.name: tf_get_corridor_state
tools.description: Corridor lifecycle stage for every demo token (Titan Ghost application logic; LIVE_TESTNET or SIMULATION track).

tools.name: tf_get_corridor
tools.description: Corridor state for one demo token code.

code.description: Three-letter demo token code, e.g. BBL

tools.name: tf_get_sentinel_coverage
tools.description: TG Sentinel coverage map: each monitored subsystem (ledger freshness, fills, depth, payments, vendors, ...), whether it is observed on this node, last check, open findings by severity and the data source used.

tools.name: tf_get_theater_state
tools.description: Titan Ghost Engine Theater state: real LIVE_TESTNET fill telemetry (demo accounts, organic:false), MAINNET_OBSERVED sample, SIMULATION model metadata, and the fill-observation source (QuickNode or public).

tools.name: tf_get_spokes
tools.description: 26-spoke XRP hub snapshot (MAINNET_OBSERVED read-only + Testnet demo spokes).

tools.name: tf_get_x402_catalog
tools.description: TG Merchant x402 data catalog (prices in Testnet drops). Discovery only; paying requires the owner's approval outside the agent.

tools.name: tf_get_vendor_status
tools.description: Vendor integration status with evidence (connected / tested / credentials required / sandbox / documentation only).

tools.name: tf_get_merchant_flow
tools.description: TG Merchant agentic-commerce flow: x402 challenge, payment intent, Guardian spending-policy verdict, approval gate and audit record. Never executes a payment.
